reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (open-data CSV of tender notices). Lane `assist` → **keep**. Confidence medium.

reason: Remaining gap: CSV response parsing with client-side row filtering. The only machine-readable access is CSV file downloads (open.canada.ca dataset 6abd20d4-7a1c-4b38-baa2-9525d0bb2fd2): https://canadabuys.canada.ca/opendata/pub/openTenderNotice-ouvertAvisAppelOffres.csv ('Open tender notices', refreshed each morning) and newTenderNotice-…csv (every two hours); there is no query API. The runtime parses JSON and XML responses (and, since 2026-09-25, sends multipart and signed requests) but still cannot parse a CSV body or filter/page its rows. Bids go through CanadaBuys / SAP Ariba.
